page.overview:
Who is Emperor Chang Wu?

The Emperor has unprinted bright red legs, and a bright red torso printed with a large golden necklace and medallion. His arms are bright red, and he has bright yellow hands. He wears a black Emperor Mantle cape, and has a bright yellow face printed with a black moustache, black cheekbones, slanted black eyes, and a black braided ponytail on the back.

Chang Wu is a Chinese mandarin and the "false emperor" who rules the city of Xi'an from his Dragon Fortress using his army of Dragon Fortress Guards. He had Jing Lee's father shot for opposing his rule. He teams up with Lord Sam Sinister, hatching an evil plan to stop the Adventurers and retrieve the treasure of Marco Polo first. Together, they find the Golden Helmet, which was hanging directly above Chang Wu's throne.

Emperor Chang Wu and Lord Sam Sinister consistently capture the Adventurers when they enter the Dragon Fortress, although his fate varies based upon the story. In the 7419 set comic, Chang Wu is knocked unconscious when Jing Lee opens a trap door directly above him, dropping one of his guards and several bricks on top of him. In 4215473 Die Suche nach dem Goldenen Drachen, Chang Wu is defeated by Jing Lee and her fellow Chinese rebels. In Episode 09, Chang Wu remains undefeated at the end of the story, ordering his guards to fire the catapult at the Adventurers as they escape in their half-track.

In the Orient Expedition board game, Chang Wu is a baddie with +4 Luck, +4 Speed, and +4 Strength, plus the stats of any item he holds. The instructions show Chang Wu positioned on the board near the Dragon Fortress, where a player must face him if they wish to pass. If the player rolls higher than Chang Wu's chosen skill factor, he gives up his item.
